'''Alexandre Bouzdine (Buzdin)''' ({{langx|ru|Александр Иванович Буздин}}; born March 16, 1954) is a French and Russian theoretical physicist in the field of [[superconductivity]] and [[condensed matter physics]]. He was awarded the [[Fernand Holweck Medal and Prize|Holweck Medal]] in physics in 2013 <ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.iop.org/news/13/dec/page_62085.html |title=Holweck Medal and Prize is presented to Alexander Buzdin |publisher=Iop.org |date=2013-12-05 |access-date=2014-03-13}}</ref> and obtained the [[Gay-Lussac Humboldt Prize]] in 2019 <ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.loma.cnrs.fr/prix-gay-lussac-humboldt-pour-a-bouzdine/ |title=Gay-Lussac Humboldt Prize presented to Alexander Buzdin  |date=2019-04-30 |access-date=2019-05-01}}</ref> for his theoretical contributions in the field of coexistence between [[superconductivity]] and [[magnetism]].

==Biography==
Since 1996, Alexandre Bouzdine has been working in the [[University of Bordeaux]] in [[France]], where he has become a professor of the exceptional class<ref>[[:fr:Professeur des universités]]</ref> in 2009. He is a [[condensed matter physics]] theory group leader at the Laboratory of Waves and Materials.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.loma.cnrs.fr/ |title=Laboratoire Ondes et Matière d'Aquitaine |publisher=Loma.cnrs.fr |access-date=2014-03-13}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://dphys.crphy.u-bordeaux1.fr/actu/ActuDPhy.htm |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140313141207/http://dphys.crphy.u-bordeaux1.fr/actu/ActuDPhy.htm |archive-date=2014-03-13 |title=Page - ActuDphy |publisher=Dphys.crphy.u-bordeaux1.fr |access-date=2014-03-13 }}</ref>

Bouzdine contributed into the theory of the inhomogeneous [[Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov phase]] in the superconducting state. In his pioneering theoretical studies of [[Ferromagnetic superconductor|superconductor-ferromagnet]] (S-F) multilayer systems he found a damped oscillatory behaviour of the superconducting order parameter in the ferromagnetic layer. This unusual S/F proximity effect leads to many interesting phenomena predicted by Bouzdine: the formation of the S-F-S [[Pi Josephson junction]];  the oscillations of the [[density of states]] with thickness in an F-layer being in contact with a superconductor; the spin-valve effect in F-S-F structures. All these observations are of a major importance for the superconducting [[spintronics]] and dynamic interaction between magnetic and superconducting subsystems.<ref>{{cite journal|title=Rev. Mod. Phys. 77, 935 (2005) - Proximity effects in superconductor-ferromagnet heterostructures |publisher=Journals.aps.org |date=2005-09-21 |doi=10.1103/RevModPhys.77.935 |arxiv=cond-mat/0505583 |last1=Buzdin |first1=A. I. |journal=Reviews of Modern Physics |volume=77 |issue=3 |page=935 |bibcode=2005RvMP...77..935B |s2cid=119338212 }}</ref>

==Honours and awards==
In 2019, Bouzdine received the [[Gay-Lussac Humboldt Prize]] for his work in the field of [[supraconductivity]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.loma.cnrs.fr/prix-gay-lussac-humboldt-pour-a-bouzdine/ |title=La fondation Alexander von Humboldt attribue le prix Gay-Lussac Humboldt au Professeur Alexandre Bouzdine |date=2019-04-30 |access-date=2019-05-01}}</ref>

Bouzdine was offered the [[Leverhulme Trust]] Visiting Professorship in 2016 at the [[University of Cambridge]] ([[St John's College, Cambridge|St John's College]]) in the United Kingdom.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.leverhulme.ac.uk/sites/default/files/AR_2016.pdf |title=Annual Review 2016 of the Leverhulme Trust|publisher=Leverhulme Trust |date=2017-01-01 |access-date=2019-03-08}}</ref>

Bouzdine was awarded the 2013 [[Holweck Prize]], a joint award by the British [[Institute of Physics]] and the Société Française de Physique<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.sfpnet.fr/index.php |title=SFP - Société Française de Physique |publisher=Sfpnet.fr |access-date=2014-03-13}}</ref> for his pioneering theoretical studies of the multilayer systems of [[ferromagnetic superconductor]]s.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.loma.cnrs.fr/spip.php?article401 |title=Laboratoire Ondes et Matière d'Aquitaine - Prix et médaille Holweck pour Alexandre Bouzdine |publisher=Loma.cnrs.fr |date=2009-06-30 |access-date=2014-03-13 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140313112716/http://www.loma.cnrs.fr/spip.php?article401 |archive-date=2014-03-13 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.cnrs.fr/inp/spip.php?article2319 |title=Institut de physique - CNRS - Alexandre Bouzdine, spécialiste de la supraconductivité, reçoit le prix et la médaille Holweck |publisher=Cnrs.fr |access-date=2014-03-13}}</ref> In 2004 he has been elected a Senior Member of the [[Institut Universitaire de France]] and holds the Chair "Physics of Superconductivity".<ref>{{cite web|url=http://iuf.amue.fr/author/abouzdine/ |title=Alexandre Bouzdine |publisher=IUF |date=2011-05-17 |access-date=2014-03-13 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140313085253/http://iuf.amue.fr/author/abouzdine/ |archive-date=2014-03-13 }}</ref>
Bouzdine is an expert for European programs as INTAS,<ref>{{cite web|url=http://cordis.europa.eu/programme/rcn/493_en.html |title=European Commission : Cordis: Programmes |publisher=Cordis.europa.eu |access-date=2014-03-13}}</ref> for ANR<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.agence-nationale-recherche.fr/ |title=Le financement sur projets au service de la recherche &#124; ANR - Agence Nationale de la Recherche |publisher=Agence-nationale-recherche.fr |access-date=2014-03-13}}</ref> and AERES,<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.aeres-evaluation.fr/ |title=Accueil |language=fr |publisher=Aeres-evaluation.fr |access-date=2014-03-13}}</ref> for Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (UK),<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.epsrc.ac.uk/Pages/default.aspx |title=Home Page - EPSRC |publisher=Epsrc.ac.uk |date=2013-12-11 |access-date=2014-03-13 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140318234654/http://www.epsrc.ac.uk/Pages/default.aspx |archive-date=2014-03-18 }}</ref> for COST,<ref>{{cite web|author= |url=http://www.cost.eu/about_cost/who/%28type%29/5/%28wid%29/33225 |title=COST &#124; Who's Who |publisher=Cost.eu |date=2013-11-14 |access-date=2014-03-13}}</ref> for German-Israeli Foundation for Scientific [[Research and development|Research and Development]],<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.gif.org.il/Pages/default.aspx |title=German-Israeli Foundation for Scientific Research and Development |publisher=GIF |access-date=2014-03-13 |archive-date=2019-11-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191117111300/http://www.gif.org.il/Pages/default.aspx |url-status=dead }}</ref> [[National Science Foundation]] (USA),<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.nsf.gov/ |title=National Science Foundation |publisher=Nsf.gov |access-date=2014-03-13}}</ref> an expert of Programme Metusalem with the Belgium government,<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.kuleuven.be/research/keydomains/methusalem/ |title=KU Leuven |publisher=Kuleuven.be |access-date=2014-03-13 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140313082451/http://www.kuleuven.be/research/keydomains/methusalem/ |archive-date=2014-03-13 }}</ref> and expert for the Netherland Science Foundation.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nwo.nl/en |title=Welcome to NWO |publisher=Nwo.nl |access-date=2014-03-13}}</ref>
Other awards include:
* 2014 Election as Foreign Member in the [http://www.istitutolombardo.it Instituto Lombardo Accademia di Scienze e Lettere] in Italy <ref>{{cite web|author=Loma |url=https://www.loma.cnrs.fr/nomination-academie-de-milan/ |title=Nomination Académie de Milan |publisher=Loma.cnrs.fr |date=2014-10-11 |access-date=2019-03-08 }}</ref>;
* 2013	        Chevalier of the [[Ordre des Palmes Académiques]], French Minister of Education<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.loma.cnrs.fr/spip.php?article394 |title=Laboratoire Ondes et Matière d'Aquitaine - Alexandre Bouzdine reçoit les Palmes Académiques |publisher=Loma.cnrs.fr |date=2009-06-30 |access-date=2014-03-13 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140313105226/http://www.loma.cnrs.fr/spip.php?article394 |archive-date=2014-03-13 }}</ref>.

==Interest in popularisation of science==
Bouzdine has contributed to the popularization of physics: he was a President of [[Soviet Student Olympiads|Olympiads in Physics in Russia]] and later in France, the Editor of the series of popular books in physics:,<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.nsta.org/quantum/backgrnd.asp |title=All About Quantum |publisher=Nsta.org |access-date=2014-03-13 |archive-date=2013-05-29 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130529142946/http://www.nsta.org/quantum/backgrnd.asp }}</ref> the Editor of the [[Kvant (magazine)|Russian popular magazine in physics "KVANT"]]  and one of the founders and a field Editor of the American - Russian students magazine on physics and mathematics "[https://web.archive.org/web/20120308132416/http://www.nsta.org/quantum/ Quantum]". He gives public popular lectures on physics, participates in the festival of Sciences in France, Italy, Belgium and Russia.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.larecherche.fr/savoirs/prix-nobel/physique-heritage-lev-landau-01-01-2004-76787 |title=Physique l'héritage de Lev Landau &#124; La Recherche |publisher=Larecherche.fr |access-date=2014-03-13 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140313070646/http://www.larecherche.fr/savoirs/prix-nobel/physique-heritage-lev-landau-01-01-2004-76787 |archive-date=2014-03-13 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://kvant.mccme.ru/au/buzdin_a.htm |title=Журнал "Квант" |publisher=Kvant.mccme.ru |access-date=2014-03-13}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://sfp2011.sciencesconf.org/browse/author?authorid=175304 |title=Congres General de la Societe Francaise de Physique|publisher=Sfp2011.sciencesconf.org |access-date=2014-03-13}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://cst.univ-pau.fr/live/evenements/cafes/ |title=Cafés des sciences / Conférences |publisher=Cst.univ-pau.fr |access-date=2014-03-13}}</ref>

==Selected publications==
Bouzdine is the author of more than 250 articles published in ''[[Nature (journal)|Nature]]'', ''[[Nature Materials]]'', ''[http://journals.aps.org/prb/ Physical Review B]'', ''[http://journals.aps.org/prl/ Physical Review Letters]'', ''[http://www.journals.elsevier.com/physica-c-superconductivity-and-its-applications/ Physica C]'', ''[http://www.journals.elsevier.com/physica-b-condensed-matter/ Physica B]'', ''[[EPL (journal)|Europhysics Letters]]'', ''[[Advances in Physics]]'', ''[http://journals.aps.org/rmp/ Review of Modern Physics]''. He is a member of Editorial Committee of the journal ''[http://www.sciencedirect.com/science/journal/16310705 Comptes Rendus de l'Académie des Sciences. Physique]''.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.em-consulte.com/en/produit/comren |title=Comptes Rendus Physique - EM&#124;consulte |publisher=Em-consulte.com |access-date=2014-03-13}}</ref> He was an invited speaker on many International and National Conferences on Low Temperature Physics, Superconductivity and Magnetism.
